d: US Midterms 2026 are underway, and President Donald Trump is warning of a major political showdown if Democrats take control of Congress. Trump has threatened mass vetoes if Republicans lose their grip on Capitol Hill, raising questions about how a divided government could affect his agenda. Could a Democratic victory trigger a legislative standoff in Washington? What would it mean for Trump's policies, the economy and America's role in the world? Hem Kaur Saroya explains on Vantage tonight.
